title: What Intent-Based Programming Is
definition: Intent-Based Programming: programming by stating intent, not instructions.
description:
Intent-Based Programming — Signature Edition: programming by stating intent, not instructions. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature intent hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: intent parsers rethought, intent logistics rebuilt, ambiguity resolution reimagined for the century ahead. This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the spec synthesis ambition that defines the Signature line.

title: Readiness Estimator: Intent-Based Programming
definition: Estimates Intent-Based Programming readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Intent-Based Programming components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a intent hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Intent-Based Programming Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Intent-Based Programming operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Intent-Based Programming installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 9278 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where intent parsers monitoring, intent logistics redundancy, or ambiguity resolution maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Intent-Based Programming Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Intent-Based Programming: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Intent-Based Programming — programming by stating intent, not instructions.

Phase 1 — Prove (intent parsers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (intent logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (ambiguity resolution): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (spec synthesis): intent hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and developers-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
